description: Land Title Settlement Department - Galwadugoda, Four Gravets Galle D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for specific parcels in Galle District. It contains detailed information about land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, encumbrances, and legal determinations regarding land titles, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
